acceptance_criterion: Recognize actual missing/cropped semantic labels in beta without inventing analogous issues in alpha; grade per existing anchors. No fixed target score. Exact image delivery, evidence coverage and semantic feedback audited separately.

construction_history.001: First controller render revealed avoidable numeric annotation proximity in nominal clean image; no model used.
construction_history.002: Adjusted left/right numeric offsets; line could pass behind text, no model used.
construction_history.003: White text background gives readable numeric labels; generic judge prompt unchanged throughout all rendering revisions. Only003 sent to judges.

controller_rendering: New CPU-only Docker container per image, no network; trusted renderer reads staged CSV. Audit/artifacts in fixture case cpu_session, no research-agent run represented.
different_scientific_context_from_prior_: Synthetic CPU inference latency by categorical batch size

review_expectations.behavior: Readable labels and legend; do not invent a defect.
XAxis tick labels clipped at lower edge; legend below canvas and absent, preventing reliable standalone condition/series decoding.

generalization_limit: Single controlled pair on simple line chart; not independent population-level validation or proof all visual bugs detectable.
model_exposure: Expectations and fixture labels are outside records. Only generic neutral task IDs alpha/beta and reference sent; independent native contexts. Generator is disclosed as normal task evidence, so not a pixel-only blinded test.

pre_model_visual_review.alpha: 1200x750 image: all six correct values, axes, metric direction, batch labels, and unambiguous two-series legend readable. No intended defect.
pre_model_visual_review.beta: same correct points/numbers and narrative; batch tick labels, x-axis title and legend lie below fixed image canvas and are not visible. The image alone cannot reliably map color/marker to implementation or horizontal position to condition.
